name: CreateAuthorizationRule

parameters.help_en: The name of the authorization rule. The name can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则名称，长度限制最大64个字符
parameters.name: authorization_rule_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the project associated with the authorization rule. If you are unsure about the associated project, you can associate the default project. The default project is iprj_system_default
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则关联的项目ID，当不确定关联项目时，可关联默认项目，默认项目为iprj_system_default
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The scope of authorized resources. Valid values:
custom: Resources within the specified project scope
parameters.help_zh:
授权资源范围。取值可选范围：
custom：指定项目范围下的资源
parameters.name: authorization_resource_scope

parameters.help_en: The description of the authorization rule. The description can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则描述，长度限制最大128个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The scenario label of the authorization rule. The label can be up to 64 characters in length.
When a label value is specified, the business layer restricts the authorized resource types based on the label.
For historical reasons, an empty attribute is also considered an enum value. When it is empty, the authorized resource types supported by other enum values are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
授权规则场景标签，长度限制最大64个字符。
当指定标签值时，业务层会基于标签限制授权资源类型。
由于历史原因，“属性为空”也可视为一个枚举值。即为空时不支持其他枚举值支持的授权资源类型
parameters.name: authorization_rule_scenario_label

parameters.help_en:
The subject type to which the authorization rule applies. Valid values:
user
application
user (for human users) or application (for machine users). When explicitly specified, it only supports privileged cloud account rules with a custom resource scope. If this field is omitted for custom scope rules in this scenario, the default value is user
parameters.help_zh:
授权规则适用的主体类别
user
application
user（人用）或 application（机用）。显式传入时仅支持自定义资源范围的特权云账号规则。该场景的自定义范围规则省略此字段时默认为 user
parameters.name: subject_type

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the parameter value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see References: How to ensure idempotence (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《如何保证幂等性 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》
parameters.name: client_token
